proposals.name: Amateur Radio & DXing (Ham Radio) Operators
proposals.buyer_persona: Older, tech-oriented hobbyists who communicate globally via radio waves. They collect physical 'QSL cards' to confirm contacts, love vintage schematics, and pride themselves on technical jargon.
product_angles: Printable QSL card templates (digital downloads for DIY printing)
Radio logbook journals with structured tables for frequency, power, and signal reports (KDP)
Patent art posters of historic radio keys and vacuum tubes (Redbubble)
proposals.first_test_product: Minimalist amateur radio contact logbook with a high-quality blueprint cover generated via Together AI (FLUX)

proposals.name: Fantasy Console (PICO-8 / TIC-80) Game Developers
proposals.buyer_persona: Indie game developers building retro 8-bit games within strict virtual hardware constraints. They love physical cheat-sheets, pixel art, and clean code optimization.
product_angles: 1-page API cheat-sheet posters and desk mats (Redbubble/Etsy)
8x8 pixel art asset packs, tilemaps, and sprite sheets (Itch.io/Etsy/Gamedev)
Physical game design notebooks with grid structures optimized for 128x128 resolution planning (KDP)
proposals.first_test_product: Retro-themed PICO-8 physical development planner with 16x16 sprite drafting grids

proposals.name: Speleology & Cave Exploration (Cavers)
proposals.buyer_persona: Extreme outdoor enthusiasts who map and explore underground caves. They use highly specialized gear (SRT - Single Rope Technique) and have a strong insider culture distinct from climbers.
product_angles: Cave survey logbooks and sketchbooks with waterproof-style cover graphics (KDP)
Insider humor t-shirts featuring caving terms like 'Squeeze', 'Sump', 'Karst', or 'SRT' (Redbubble)
Vector SVG packs of cave topography symbols and mapping icons for digital cartography (Etsy)
proposals.first_test_product: Cave Survey & Expedition Logbook with specialized grids for depth, azimuth, and inclination mapping

proposals.name: Traditional Bowyers & Historical Archery Guilds
proposals.buyer_persona: Craftsmen who build wooden longbows/recurve bows by hand and participate in traditional target or 3D field archery. They appreciate medieval history, wood grain aesthetics, and precise tuning.
product_angles: Target scoring logbooks for traditional archery meets (KDP)
Detailed vector SVG designs of historical archers, crestings, and medieval guild seals (Etsy)
proposals.first_test_product: Historical Bowyer's Tillering Journal containing wood specification sheets and draw-weight curves

proposals.name: Hydroponic & Aquaponic Urban Micro-Farmers
proposals.buyer_persona: Tech-savvy indoor gardeners using water-based systems to grow food in tight spaces. They track water pH, EC levels, nutrient ratios, and pump schedules religiously.
product_angles: System layout blueprints and vector SVGs of plumbing loops for DIY builders (Etsy)
3D printable modular net pots, pipe clips, and water manifold fittings (Cults3D)
Daily water chemistry and nutrient dosing logbooks (KDP)
proposals.first_test_product: Parametric 3D printable spacer rings and net-pot adapters optimized for standard PVC pipe sizing

proposals.name: Local French 'Chambres d'Hôtes' (B&Bs) & Tiny Houses
proposals.buyer_persona: Micro-hospitality owners in rural France looking to offer premium, local experiences to tourists. They need elegant, cheap physical assets to brand their properties.
product_angles: Bespoke regional coloring booklets for children of guests (B2B digital license or physical KDP)
Customizable guest welcome book templates with local hiking trails and maps (Etsy/Digital)
Minimalist local monument art posters for wall decoration in guest rooms (Redbubble)
proposals.first_test_product: A regional coloring book template of Dordogne/Provence heritage sites, licensable to local B&B owners
